summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the refactored Laboratorios Horvath multi-view SPA with i18n and back-to-top. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (health, POST /api/leads whatsapp+email, GET sorted+persist, missing-name validation). Frontend: routing between / /personas /empresas /nosotros /contacto works via NavLinks without full reload; language toggle switches all copy (H1 '40 años cuidando tu salud,' <-> '40 years caring for your health,'; nav labels Inicio<->Home etc.) and persists via localStorage across reload; Personas has 4 service cards and digital-menu button href correctly switches between /assets/menus/menu-es.pdf and /assets/menus/menu-en.pdf per language; Empresas has 3 service cards and correct B2B hero; Nosotros gallery has all 4 filter tabs, filter click works, lightbox opens and closes on Escape, and gallery is NOT rendered on Home; Home shows both hero-persona and hero-empresa path cards; back-to-top toggles show class after scrolling past ~500px and scrolls to top on click; Contact form POSTs a lead with channel=whatsapp and shows form-success. Zero console errors.

issues: Minor: show state is only recomputed on scroll events; when Layout scrolls to top on route change, if the browser fires no synthetic scroll event the button may retain the previous show=true class briefly until the user scrolls again. Not user-visible in practice.

critical_code_review_comments: BackToTop: attach a route-change effect (useLocation) to re-evaluate window.scrollY so the button hides when route change scrolls to top.
Personas.jsx / Contacto.jsx: menu PDFs are ~33MB static files under /assets/menus — consider hosting via CDN with cache headers or serving from a smaller optimized PDF.
server.py: /api/leads still lacks pagination and any input length/anti-spam limits. Fine for MVP but worth throttling before public launch.
Contacto.jsx: still swallows POST errors (only console.error). Consider surfacing a subtle inline error toast when the lead fails to save so users know to retry.
seed_data_creation: A few TEST_-prefixed leads created via API + one via UI (TEST_Playwright User, whatsapp). No delete endpoint; not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All refactor acceptance criteria met: multi-view routing, full ES/EN i18n with real content changes + localStorage persistence, menu-es.pdf/menu-en.pdf href swap on Personas, gallery moved to /nosotros only, back-to-top visibility+click, contact form still POSTs to /api/leads and shows form-success. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_horvath_api.py (5 tests) all pass against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. No fixes were needed in this iteration.
